mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical Wilder Parabolic SAR reversal on completed four-hour BTC auctions marks a path-dependent trend state flip after price penetrates its accelerating trailing stop; follow the new SAR trend for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a completed-bar reversal from short SAR state to long; short on reversal from long SAR state to short
mechanism.why_distinct: HVPSAR is a recursive path-dependent stop-and-reverse state using extrema and a fixed acceleration schedule, not a channel crossing, oscillator, quote-volume pressure, OI, funding, premium, or Gross9 state primitive.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, while SAR reversals identify directional state changes within that regime
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour recursive stop-and-reverse clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.initialization: after each gap, initialize on first two valid bars: long when second close>=first close else short; initial SAR=min lows for long or max highs for short; initial extreme=max highs or min lows
features.recursion: project prior SAR plus AF*(prior extreme-prior SAR), clamp to previous two lows/highs by trend, reverse on strict penetration, otherwise update extreme and AF
features.signal: state differs from immediately prior valid SAR state
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Wilder Parabolic SAR reversal under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no acceleration schedule, initialization, recursion, clamp, reversal, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: J. Welles Wilder Jr., Parabolic Time/Price System
external_basis.fixed_definition: SAR acceleration starts 0.02, increases 0.02 on each new trend extreme, caps 0.20; projected SAR is clamped by the previous two lows in a long state or highs in a short state; penetration reverses state
external_basis.selection_use: published recursion, acceleration schedule, and stop-and-reverse direction only; no incidence or outcomes
